snippet.title: Core Diggers - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4505270/Core_Diggers?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=promotion

Core Diggers is a cooperative science-fiction digging game wherein players land on an alien planet, equipped with the best of gear and tools. The aim of the game is for players to discover and explore this planet, mine valuable mineral resources, collect ancient and rare artifacts, and learn about all the mysteries surrounding this planet’s core.
